title: Microsoft Classroom: a standalone Microsoft 365 Education app for teaching and learning
summary: The briefing incorrectly says Microsoft Learn does not describe Classroom's behaviour: its cited portfolio and FAQ pages already describe Classroom's capabilities. The roadmap targets, licensing statements and Learning Activities controls are supported, while Classroom-specific availability controls and its default remain undocumented.
